response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ year experience requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack work spanning TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, plus recent hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a rare and explicitly required skill. His strong testing culture (TDD, authoring test frameworks, testing workshops) aligns well with the role's quality focus. Gaps are mostly in specific stack items (Nest.js, Kotlin, Vitest not explicitly mentioned), which are learnable given his demonstrated polyglot adaptability. Note: he appears to be a current re:cinq employee, which the hiring team should be aware of when processing this application.
strengths: Deep full-stack experience with core stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes)
Direct AI-agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, authored test frameworks, ran testing workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright experience listed
No Kotlin or Python exposure; secondary JVM stack coverage is limited to older Java work
Frontend history leans heavily on Ember.js; React experience appears limited to one recent role
